original.target_description: Study 1a, university student sample; Pearson correlation of UCLA loneliness with the standardized bathing frequency/duration/temperature physical warmth extraction index.

n.quote: Fifty-one undergraduates (26 females, and 25 males) were recruited for the study outside of their dining hall in exchange for $2.
